comments.author: Kurama
comments.body: Any ideia what is it for?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Used to enhance the attack value of Landsknecht Clothing outfit (up to 100 attack on JP servers, limit for Maris currently unknown).

Source: blog.goo.ne.jp/triptych/e/29e6079bae66bb372d2bd35af7e5cf52

comments.author: Monarchy
comments.body:
forge using transmutation is possible up to 25 times (regardless of base performance)

forge using recipe is possible until the figure reaches 100 (regardless of times)

comments.author: Monarchy
comments.body:
for example:
1) forging Sea Dragon's Circlet by Improve Attack Power (improve atk by transmutation), you can improve this one atk 10 to 35

also if Fool's Hands's def reached 37 (12+25) you can not use Armoursmith's Forging Tools to forge this one

2) forging Fool's Hands by John Dee's Alchemy (improve def by recipe), you can improve this one def 12 to 100 regardless of attempts. in this case, you can use this recipe even if current def is 37 or higher.

comments.author: Monarchy
comments.body:
summary:
forging Fool's Hands by Armoursmith's Forging Tools (forging tool) : def 12 -> 37 (limit)
forging Fool's Hands by John Dee's Alchemy (recipe) : def 12 -> 100 (limit)
forging Sea Dragon's Circlet by Improve Attack Power (transmutation) : atk 10 -> 35 (limit)

※ forging Fool's Hands by Improve Attack Power is not available because base atk of Fool's Hands is zero. required each 1+ atk/def to transmutate

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I am told by goncalo that the recipe for enhancing Landsknecht Clothing is indeed available on Maris. Cheers.
